setup.askHours:
⚙️ *Let's set up your work schedule!*

*Step 1 of 5 — Daily hours*

How many hours do you work per day?

Example: `8.8` (= 8 hours and 48 minutes)
setup.chooseWorkdays:
*Step 2 of 5 — Workdays*

Choose your workdays:

1. Sunday–Thursday
2. Monday–Friday
3. Custom
setup.askCustomWorkdays:
Enter your workdays as comma-separated numbers:

0=Sunday, 1=Monday, 2=Tuesday, 3=Wednesday, 4=Thursday, 5=Friday, 6=Saturday

Example: `0,1,2,3,4`
setup.chooseTimezone:
*Step 3 of 5 — Timezone*

Choose your timezone:

1. Asia/Jerusalem
2. Europe/London
3. Europe/Berlin
4. America/New\_York
5. Custom (IANA format)
setup.askCustomTimezone:
Enter your timezone in IANA format:

Example: `Asia/Jerusalem`
setup.askVacationRate:
*Step 4 of 5 — Vacation accrual rate*

How many vacation days should you accrue per month worked?

Default: `1`. Send `skip` to use the default.

Example: `1.5`
setup.askSickRate:

How many sick days should you accrue per month worked?

help:
📖 *WorkHours Bot — Available commands*

/start          — Start today's workday
/status         — Show today's active status
/end            — End today's active workday
/record         — View today's record
/record dd-mm   — View record for a specific date
/edit dd-mm     — Edit or fix a specific date
/week           — Show current week summary
/month          — Show current month summary
/balance        — Show vacation/sick day balances
/settings       — Show current settings
/settings\_edit — Edit settings
/help           — Show this message

menu.setStartAndEndInstead: Set start and end hours instead
menu.wholeDay: Set the whole day as one period
menu.logHours: Log hours worked (keeps the half day)
menu.logHoursAsOne: Log hours worked as one period (keeps the half day)
menu.convertToWork: Turn into a regular work day

edit.promptAddPeriod:
Enter the start and end time of the new work period:

Example: 15:00-18:30
edit.promptChoosePeriodToEdit: Which work period do you want to change? Send its number (1–{{max}}).
edit.promptChoosePeriodToDelete: Which work period do you want to delete? Send its number (1–{{max}}).
edit.invalidChoosePeriod: ❌ Send a work period number between 1 and {{max}}.
edit.promptEditPeriod:
Enter the new start and end time for work period {{periodNumber}}:

Example: 15:00-18:30
edit.confirmDeleteLastPeriod:
Delete *{{range}}*? {{date}} will have no hours left, so its record will be removed.

Send *yes* to confirm, or any other message to cancel.
edit.confirmDeleteLastPeriodHalfDay:
Delete *{{range}}*? {{date}} will have no hours left; its {{absenceLabel}} (half day) stays.

Send *yes* to confirm, or any other message to cancel.
edit.promptEditOnlyPeriod:
Enter the new start and end time for this work period:

Example: 15:00-18:30
edit.invalidTimeRangeFormat:
❌ *Invalid input.*

Use the format HH:MM-HH:MM, e.g. {{example}}.

Send different times, or any other command to stop.
edit.invalidTimeFormat:
❌ *Invalid input.*

Use the format HH:MM, e.g. 17:30.

Send a different time, or any other command to stop.
edit.periodDeletedNoRecord:
✅ *Work period deleted*

{{date}} has no hours logged now, so its record was removed.
edit.promptLogHours:
Enter the start and end time you worked:

Example: 13:00-17:30
edit.promptConvertToWork:
This removes the half-day absence (any leave debit is refunded).

Enter start and end time for the full work day:

Example: 08:15-17:30
edit.halfDayHoursSaved:
✅ *Hours saved*

📅 Date:      *{{date}}*

🕐 Start:     *{{startStr}}*

errors.userSettingsNotFound:
⚙️ *You haven't configured your account yet.*

Run `/setup` to get started.
errors.dailyRecordAlreadyExists:
⚠️ *You've already started today's workday.*

Use `/status` to check your progress or `/end` when you're done.
errors.activeRecordNotFound:
⚠️ *No active workday found.*

Use `/start` to begin your day, or `/edit dd-mm` to log or fix a past date.
errors.workPeriodLimitReached:
⚠️ *Today already has {{max}} work periods* — that's the daily limit.

To change today's hours, use `/edit dd-mm` with today's date.
errors.dayMarkedAsAbsence:
📋 *Today is marked as {{absenceLabel}}.*

There are no hours to log on a full-day absence. To change it, use `/edit dd-mm` with today's date.
errors.dailyRecordAlreadyClosed:
⚠️ *Today's workday is already closed.*

Use `/start` to log another work period, or `/week` to see your weekly summary.
errors.dailyRecordAlreadyClosedNoMorePeriods:
⚠️ *Today's workday is already closed.*

Use `/edit dd-mm` with today's date to change today's hours, or `/week` to see your weekly summary.
errors.setupAlreadyCompleted:
✅ *Setup is already complete.*

Use `/settings` to view your settings or `/settings\_edit` to change them.
errors.unknown: ❌ *Something went wrong.* Please try again later.
